title: CodeSage
subtitle: AI-Powered Deterministic Code Explanation Engine
summary: Built an AI-powered code explanation engine with a 6-stage compiler pipeline and custom recursive-descent parser, eliminating external LLM API costs by 100% and reducing latency by 40%.

architecture.detail: Tokenizes Python code using regex-based scanner into typed tokens.
Custom recursive-descent parser building a syntax tree supporting 5+ Python constructs.
Constructs 15+ node types with parent-child linkage and scope tracking.
Traverses AST nodes deterministically to generate semantic function summaries.
Seq2seq model trained on 5,000 code-summary pairs (30 epochs) for natural phrasing.
Tkinter visualizer rendering AST node hierarchies and plain-English breakdown.

highlights: Engineered custom recursive-descent parser without relying on Python's native `ast` module.
Trained custom seq2seq BiLSTM model to synthesize natural language explanations from AST tokens.
Replaced costly GPT-4o-mini calls with internal deterministic AST rule engine, achieving 0 API dependency.
Built clean interactive GUI visualizing AST parent-child nodes side-by-side with code execution logic.
hciHighlights: Adheres to Shneiderman's 8 Golden Rules by yielding immediate visual closure; F-pattern layout with dual-pane code and AST inspection.

title: eDNA Taxonomy & Biodiversity
subtitle: Metagenomic Analysis Pipeline with VAE & HDBSCAN Clustering
summary: High-throughput environmental DNA analysis pipeline compressing 20k+ sequences via Variational Autoencoders (87.5% reduction) and discovering novel OTUs with HDBSCAN.

architecture.detail: Converts raw FASTQ/FASTA into 256-dimensional k-mer frequency representations.
Variational Autoencoder compresses 256-dim k-mer vectors down to 32 latent dimensions.
HDBSCAN isolates 8+ species clusters and detects ~20% novel Operational Taxonomic Units (OTUs).
Flask API serves 2D UMAP projection and calculates 4 biodiversity metrics (Shannon, Simpson, Pielou, Richness).

highlights: Eliminated reliance on computationally intensive reference taxonomic databases via self-supervised VAE.
Identified and flagged uncataloged marine OTUs with rigorous statistical confidence intervals (85–99%).
Calculated ecological metrics in real time: Shannon Entropy, Simpson Dominance, Pielou Evenness, and Species Richness.
Exposed REST endpoints consumed by interactive 2D visualization scatterplots.
hciHighlights: Gestalt similarity applied to cluster groupings; responsive data charts preventing visual overload (Aesthetic and Minimalist Design).

title: JobLink – AI Job Matching Platform
subtitle: Full-Stack Recruitment Portal with Groq LLM & Supabase RLS
summary: Full-stack job matching platform featuring AI resume parsing via Groq LLM, 14+ authenticated REST endpoints, and an automated match scoring engine with 85-99% accuracy.

architecture.detail: Groq LLM parses PDF/DOCX resumes into structured JSON with 5+ contact fields and 6 skill sets.
Supabase PostgreSQL with Row-Level Security (RLS) isolating candidate vs employer records.
JWT tokens with role-based access control and memory rate limiting preventing brute force.
Calculates skill intersection, experience cosine distance, and generates structured matching rationale.

highlights: Architected clean multi-tenant schema with candidate and recruiter workspaces.
Built resilient in-memory sliding window rate limiter safeguarding against API abuse.
Surfaces missing vs matched skills clearly to candidates, providing actionable feedback.
Engineered automated candidate ranking system cutting recruiter review time by 65%.
hciHighlights: Visibility of system status during multi-step resume analysis; error prevention through structured file validations.

title: FloatChat (SIH 2025)
subtitle: Retrieval-Augmented Chatbot for ARGO Ocean Float Telemetry
summary: Oceanographic conversational AI system querying global ARGO float sensors (salinity, temperature, depth) using hybrid vector retrieval and geospatial filtering.

architecture.detail: Pulls NetCDF ARGO oceanographic float profiles and generates spatiotemporal embeddings.
Combines dense vector similarity with geospatial bounding-box SQL queries.
Feeds contextual float profiles into LLM to synthesize natural oceanographic answers.
Leaflet map with interactive float trajectory markers and depth profile charts.

highlights: Built for Smart India Hackathon 2025 problem statement addressing marine and ocean data discovery.
Enables ocean researchers to ask plain English questions like 'Show salinity anomalies in Arabian Sea for Float 2901550'.
Dynamic interactive charting depicting depth vs temperature thermoclines alongside chat responses.
Designed with high-contrast marine-friendly color palettes and accessible data visualizations.
hciHighlights: Recognition over recall: interactive map and sample query chips eliminate the need to memorize float IDs or coordinates.
